author: musho7-dev
subject: Online races: 2-4 players race live to a 600 m finish line
body:
- Race server (godot --headless -- --server, ./race-server.sh): rooms of 2-4,
  random race map, passes car positions between players
- RACE ONLINE button, waiting room, 3-2-1 countdown, live position,
  other cars with name tags, finish line, results with coin prizes
- Crashes respawn you; free push when stuck; no fuel limit in races
- Practice robots (--racebot) and Local Network permission for iPhone

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
